title: RegressionLinear Predict
text: Predict responses using linear regression model, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Inner product data type} sets Inner product data type; {Select trained machine learning model} sets the linear regression model, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output data type} sets the data type of yfit output Inherit, {Output data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of yfit output for range checking, {Output data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of yfit output for range checking, {Inner product data type Minimum} sets the minimum of inner product term for range checking and {Inner product data type Maximum} sets the maximum of inner product term for range checking. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: x
ports.summary: Predictor data row vector | column vector

params.name: Select trained machine learning model
params.values: Linear regression model linearMdl (default) | RegressionLinear object

params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
